claim_boundary: This is a static, component-addressable reconstruction plan for project-authored geometry. It creates no FCStd, no STEP/STP, no CAD receipt and no manufacturing-release evidence. Existing STL visuals remain non-authoritative display assets and must never be converted to STEP as a substitute for native B-rep feature models.
